name: Baywright
summary: A fictional work-package planner for a maintenance bay. Sample data, not a real shop system.
paragraphs: Baywright, in this sample, turns a scheduled visit into the cards, parts, and people the bay needs before the aircraft arrives. The name is a placeholder.
The useful test for a real package tool is whether the bay stays full and whether the visit finishes without a missing part. This listing does not claim that result for a real product.
whyItMatters: An empty bay hour is capacity the shop already paid for. A package that arrives complete can turn that hour into sold work.
pricing: Sample pricing, not a live offer.
bestFor: Readers checking how an MRO listing is written.
